title: CLCON/222/2007 of POORAN CHANDRA BHATT Vs UTPAL KUMAR AND OTHERS

paras.text:
CLCON No. 222 of 2007
Honíble B.C. Kandpal, J.
 Sri Alok Mehra, Advocate holding brief
of Sri Manoj Tiwari, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 It has been brought to the notice of the
Court that against the impugned order
passed by the Single Bench, the special
appeal has been preferred and the same has
been admitted for consideration.
 In view of the foresaid fact, the
contempt petition is dismissed with a liberty
to file the fresh contempt petition, if the
cause of action still arises.
(B.C.K., J.)
12.12.2008
ASWAL
